content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced in-store sales, merchandising and marketing services for consumer goods brands, not freight transportation."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Professional employer organization, payroll and workers' compensation insurance for small businesses, not freight transportation."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"On-site concrete pumping for construction contractors; uses trucks but does not move freight for shippers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Seaborne LPG carriers chartered to energy producers and traders; ocean shipping, not truck freight."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Dry bulk ocean shipping of raw materials on charter; different mode and customer base from LTL trucking."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Truck-based freight transportation for North American shippers using owned tractors, with cross-border service, though truckload rather than LTL."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical, electrical and plumbing building contracting and maintenance for building owners, not freight transportation."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Dry bulk ocean freight on Supramax and Panamax vessels; a different transport mode and cargo type."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Online and live auctions and disposition of used industrial equipment and trucks; a marketplace, not freight hauling."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"On-site industrial inspection, repair and heat treating for refineries and plants; a maintenance service, not transportation."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing, leasing and highway guardrail products; equipment and rail fleet business, not freight carriage."}]}
